reason: Declares dynamic view records and fixed placement and source labels. DynamicViewRegistry and DynamicViewSessionManager own registration and session changes.
Declares desktop launch state and event records. LaunchOrchestrator controls launch progress and LaunchStore persists its history.
Declares the desktop RPC request, result and event shapes. The RPC handler slices dispatch changes to runtime, settings, update and other desktop services.
Declares trace records and fixed status and event labels. TraceService changes the session state and TraceStore persists sessions and events.
Declares desktop voice records and fixed stage, status and test labels. VoiceService and its stream coordinator own turn and playback changes.
Declares sidecar state and credential shapes and fixed default settings. The sidecar supervisor owns process and restart state, and wallet setup persists credentials.
